entities.summary: Halima Yakoy Adam is a Chadian paralegal. Drugged and strapped to an explosive device, she was forced into a crowded market in Bol, Chad on 22 December 2015. She lost two legs, but survived. After rehabilitation, she studied to become a paralegal. After that, she has worked to help other women survivors of violence in Chad.
